context: A boss and his manager review finances
purpose: Teach: 残高/納税/人件/同行/職種/命じ/多額/持ち出し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今期、残高が予想より多額に積み上がってるな。
lines.en: This quarter, the cash position is accumulating above projections.
lines.style: Measured, factual opening. Clipped, observational tone—no theatrics. The voice of someone reading a problem into existence, neither concerned nor dismissive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。納税の準備、進めています。
lines.en: Yes. We're already moving forward with tax preparation.
lines.style: Respectful, precise. Quick and clean—a subordinate confirming readiness without elaboration. Slight forward lean in the posture of the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 人件費の見直し、財務部と同行で打ち合わせを命じた。
lines.en: I've ordered Finance and HR to conduct a joint review of personnel costs.
lines.style: Authoritative but not harsh. Each clause lands with quiet certainty—a decision already made and now being communicated. No invitation for input.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。職種別の予算も、再配分が必要です。
lines.en: Understood. We'll also need to reallocate the departmental budgets.
lines.style: Professional, slightly anticipatory. Adds information without waiting to be asked—the voice of someone who's already thinking two steps ahead. Steady and efficient.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 資料を持ち出し、来週社外取締役にも見せる。
lines.en: I'm taking the files to show the outside directors next week.
lines.style: Calm statement of logistics. No sense of urgency—just matter-of-fact sequencing. The tone of someone organizing his calendar, not announcing a crisis.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Brief, competent. A small, tidy acknowledgment that the conversation is concluded. The voice of someone checking an item off without ceremony.
